title: Classic-V Street TC-3

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the Arai Classic-V Street TC-3 at 1137 grams. Built with a PB-cLc shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 safety standards.

product_details.description: Heritage styling with modern Arai protection.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: The Classic-V Street TC-3 is a retro-styled open-face helmet featuring a rounder shell profile suitable for intermediate oval head shapes. The TC-3 designation indicates track certification, which may affect comfort for long-distance street riding compared to the standard Classic-V.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in Arai's Open Face lineup, the Classic-V Street TC-3 brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
yoast_title: Arai Classic-V Street TC-3 Review: 1137g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the Arai Classic-V Street TC-3. Verified 1137g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Classic-V Street TC-3 is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low (Snug, even pressure distribution across forehead without hot-spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Open Face lineup, the Classic-V Street TC-3 brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Classic-V Street TC-3 represents Japanese head protection design, incorporates aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its PB-cLc shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a PB-cLc Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Classic-V Street TC-3 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
